blocking_issues.issue: Both editions and the reserve chart assert that USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 estimates Brazilian rare-earth reserves at 21 million tonnes REO. The latest USGS MCS 2026 version 1.3 (revised 27 May 2026) instead reports 11 million tonnes; 21 million belongs to an earlier edition/version. The cited URL points to the current full 2026 compendium, not the earlier vintage. The chart's principal Brazil observation is materially wrong for the cited source and information cutoff.

USGS publication record states MCS 2026 version 1.3 revised 27 May 2026: https://pubs.usgs.gov/publication/mcs2026
Latest USGS full report (version 1.3) and its rare-earths reserves table: https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2026/mcs2026.pdf ; https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2026/mcs2026-rare-earths.pdf
Earlier USGS version 1.2 retained the 21-million-tonne figure: https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2026/mcs2026-rare-earths_ver.1.2.pdf
